title: Stage 20 proxy-target divergence, gaming-signal, and Goodhart rejection board
hypothesis: A synthetic decision board can reject readiness when an internal proxy improves while protected target evidence is unchanged, worsens, or becomes less observable, and can prevent metric optimization from compensating for open or exact gates.
falsifier_or_gate: Mutate proxy score, target evidence, observability, countermetric, distribution, incentive, protected-gate state, reviewer independence, and promotion language; proxy-only improvement or gaming signals must fail.
evidence_class: bounded structural, proxy, open-gap, or exact-gate software evidence
boundary: Acceptance is confined to the frozen software evidence class and cannot promote empirical, participant, identity, authority, privacy, security, accessibility, deployment, or Stage 20 claims.
